snippet.title: SIKANDAR Official Trailer - Salman Khan, Rashmika | Sajid Nadiadwala | A.R. Murugadoss | 30th March
snippet.description:
Presenting the Official Trailer of Sikandar! 🔥 

Salman Khan As Sanjay Rajkot 
Rashmika Mandanna As Saisri
Sathyaraj As Minister Pradhan 

Produced by Sajid Nadiadwala 

Directed by A.R. Murugadoss 

A Nadiadwala Grandson Entertainment & Salman Film Khan Films Production

Music on Zee Music Company 
Music By Pritam
Background Music Score By Santosh Narayanan 

Sikandar Releases in cinemas Worldwide on 30th March 2025 

Get an exclusive offer on tickets for shows on 30th March only. 
Book here -: https://link.district.in/DSTRKT/sikandartrailerlaunch
